description: This file defines the ConfigEntityDependency class, which provides methods to manage and query configuration dependencies within Drupal's configuration system.

classes.name: ConfigEntityDependency
classes.description: A class that manages configuration dependencies for Drupal configuration entities.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the dependency object with a name and optional dependency values, merging enforced dependencies if present.

methods.name: getDependencies
methods.description: Returns a list of dependencies of a specified type ('module', 'theme', 'config', 'content').

methods.name: hasDependency
methods.description: Checks if the entity has a dependency of a specific type and name.

methods.name: getConfigDependencyName
methods.description: Returns the configuration dependency name of the entity.
